summary: Poneglyph is an experimental semantic graph database for Cloudflare Workers: applications append typed, sourced facts and query connected facts with a bounded Datalog language. It coordinates atomic writes across sharded Durable Objects and provides snapshot-consistent reads through a typed client and graph-scoped Worker service. The repository also includes a protected One Piece playground with browser and read-only MCP access, plus a MemoryBench adapter for comparing memory retrieval variants.
